title: Jesus was only amazed twice.
current_description: Twice in the Gospels, Jesus is described as amazed. Once by the faith of a Roman centurion — an outsider who somehow understood Jesus’ authority. (Luke 7:9) And once by the unbelief of the people in his own hometown — the people who thought they knew exactly who he was. (Mark 6:6) Faith amazed Jesus. So did its absence. Of all the things Jesus encountered, that is worth thinking about. #ChristianityApparently #Jesus #Bible #Christianity #Faith
